title: Fix off-by-one error in pagination helper
body:
This PR fixes an off-by-one bug in `paginate()` where the last page of results was silently dropped when the total count was an exact multiple of the page size. Added a regression test covering the boundary case.

Closes #482.
diff:
--- a/src/utils/paginate.py
+++ b/src/utils/paginate.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ def paginate(items, page, page_size):
     start = (page - 1) * page_size
     end = start + page_size
-    if end > len(items):
+    if end >= len(items):
         end = len(items)
     return items[start:end]
--- a/tests/test_paginate.py
+++ b/tests/test_paginate.py
@@ -20,3 +20,9 @@ def test_paginate_middle_page():
     assert paginate(list(range(30)), 2, 10) == list(range(10, 20))
+
+def test_paginate_exact_multiple_last_page():
+    items = list(range(20))
+    assert paginate(items, 2, 10) == list(range(10, 20))

title: Add CSV export endpoint for admin reports
body: Adds `GET /api/admin/reports/export.csv` which streams the monthly usage report as CSV for the admin dashboard. Reuses the existing `ReportSerializer`. Access is gated behind the `is_staff` permission check already used elsewhere in this module.
diff:
--- a/src/api/admin_reports.py
+++ b/src/api/admin_reports.py
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, Response
 from .permissions import require_staff
 from .serializers import ReportSerializer
+import csv, io
 
 admin_reports_bp = Blueprint("admin_reports", __name__)
 
@@ -18,3 +19,17 @@ def list_reports():
     reports = ReportSerializer.list_monthly()
     return jsonify(reports)
+
+@admin_reports_bp.route("/export.csv")
+@require_staff
+def export_csv():
+    reports = ReportSerializer.list_monthly()
+    buf = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=reports[0].keys())
+    writer.writeheader()
+    writer.writerows(reports)
+    return Response(buf.getvalue(), mimetype="text/csv")
